comment: Official X result-announcement status codes we probe each discovery run. Each entry carries the verifiable, curated event identity (eventId/name/region/blocks/date). This is a lightweight watch-route manifest — NOT a source JSON (it holds no deck lists) — so discovery stays sustainable: the script probes each code, records its live date, diffs against the known registry, and never re-adds what is already known. New tournaments are surfaced by adding their announcement code here. Deck codes live in the announcement images, so deck-list extraction stays a separate, human-verified backfill step.
